gate_criteria.description: No production service depends on V4 SQLite. Required history/backups and supported-client/provider compatibility remain available under policy
verified_points: V4 mutation paths permanently fenced: systemd units masked, background schedulers halted, and cron jobs disabled to prevent restart.
V4 SQLite database placed into permanent read-only archive mode (0440) with cryptographic SHA256 checksum preservation.
Cold-start recovery initializes reliably on PostgreSQL primary authority with zero reliance on SQLite existence or availability.
Service startup guard actively refuses to start if accidental V4 writer configuration or revived process is detected.
Routing and ingress tables strip write capabilities from all legacy V4 paths, ensuring no split-brain write leakage.
